shipments.title: Shipments
shipments.containerHint: Hold Ctrl/Cmd to select several. Only available containers are listed.

actions.clearanceNote: Only confirm clearance once customs has actually released the cargo. GPS arrival is not clearance.

dispatch.title: Dispatch
dispatch.intro: Create a trip for confirmed shipments, assign a vehicle and a driver, and dispatch — in one step.

map.title: Live map
map.intro: Latest trusted position of each vehicle. Colours show how fresh each position is.
map.none: No vehicle has reported a position yet.
map.feedStale: Live updates are not arriving. The map shows the last data received at {time}; positions keep ageing.
map.basemap: Base map: development tiles. Production uses self-hosted tiles.
